newsitem.title: HONG KONG: DLJ to sponsor APT Satellite's US/HK IPO - sources.
newsitem.headline: DLJ to sponsor APT Satellite's US/HK IPO - sources.

text.p: Hong Kong satellite owner and operator APT Satellite Co Ltd has named Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette the sponsor of its initial public offering in Hong Kong and the United States, market sources said.
The dual listing is expected to take place in October, sources said.
APT officials declined to comment while Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette was not available for comment.
Beijing-controlled APT is expected to raise US$200 million to US$300 million for repaying loans and buying satellites.

The company, established in Hong Kong in 1992, is owned by China's Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications, Chinese General Company of Aeronautics Industry and investors from China, Singapore, Thailand, Macau and Taiwan.
